Subject (in full) List of 51 Principal Communists arrested by the Municipal
Police in 1932.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Everest

I forward herewith, in compliance with instructions received
from the Officer i/c Special Branch, a tabulated list of the
principal communists arrested by the Municipal Police in the year
ending December 31, 1932.
The attached list, which gives brief particulars of 51
communists and their association with the Chinese Communist
Party, was compiled by Clerk Zung Zoong Oen under the guidance
of the undersigned from a total of 232 communists arrested in
the International Settlement during the period under review.

事由（全称）：1932年由工部局警务处逮捕的51名主要共产党人名单。

编制及呈报人：副巡官 Everest

兹遵照特别支部主管官员之指示，随函附上截至1932年12月31日止的一年内，由工部局警务处逮捕的主要共产党人的分类列表。
所附名单列出了51名共产党人的简要情况及其与中国共产党的关系，该名单由书记员 Zung Zoong Oen 在本人指导下，从审查期间在国际租界逮捕的总共232名共产党人中整理而成。

LIST OF PRINCIPAL COMMUNISTS ARRESTED BY THE
MUNICIPAL POLICE IN 1932.

NAMES                                      PARTICULARS

CHEN TOU SEU
(陳獨秀)
                                           Leader of the Trotsky Clique
                                           of the Chinese Communist Party.
                                               Held the post of Secretary-
                                           General of the Chinese Communist
                                           Party and was in charge of communist
                                           activities throughout China from
                                           1923 to 1927.    Attended the
                                           Congress of the Third International at
                                           Moscow as China's Chief Delegate in
                                           1925.    Since his expulsion in 1927/8
                                           from the Chinese Communist Party, he
                                           has been engaged in work directed
                                           against the Third International and the
                                           Central Executive Committee of the
                                           Chinese Communist Party and organized
                                           the so-called Trotsky Opposition Clique.
                                               On October 15, 1932, following
                                           a raid by the Municipal Police on the
                                           headquarters of the Trotsky Opposition
                                           Clique at No. 210 Tsung Yang Li (春陽里),
                                           East Yuhang Road, Chen Tou Seu was
                                           arrested at his home at 11 Yung Shing
                                           Li (永興里), Yochow Road.    He was
                                           subsequently extradited to the Chinese
                                           Authorities and is at present awaiting
                                           trial in Nanking.
